title: MSFS 2026 Roadmap: New Planes, Worlds & Fixes
description:
Microsoft just dropped a massive 2-hour Developer Stream! From the "study-level" Embraer Praetor 600 to the total overhaul of World Update 21: Australia, the 2026 roadmap is packed. We’re also breaking down the CRITICAL fixes in Sim Update 5—including the VRAM/FPS bug, the new weather radar system, and the fix for disappearing ships.

Whether you're waiting for the Piper M600 in June or the expert-level systems of the Praetor in November, this recap covers every detail you need to know to stay ahead in the sim.

Key Highlights:

- ✈️ Expert Series: Piper M600 (June) & Embraer Praetor 600 (November)
- 🇦🇺 World Update 21: 30+ POIs and handcrafted airports in Australia (May 5th)
- 🛠️ Sim Update 5: VRAM fixes, Weather Radar, and Marketplace UI redesign
- 📦 AAU4: Massive updates to the ATR, AN2, and Fokker F.VII
